commit_role: execution_commit is the allowlist commit f95a7baba880b89987c04744f5de05745d5785ac. The qualifying campaign head is e737df83f1c855ee93bccefa603193c1ff6ef02c, the parent of that commit. The evidence records are a later commit and do not change these inputs.

execution_commit_digest_check.note: Captured while HEAD was the execution commit and the evidence files were still untracked. The payload includes head, so a re-run after the evidence commit returns PASS with a different stdout hash. Inputs are unchanged.

repair_cycle_1_execution_commit_digest_c.note: Captured at 644855039d14e701d8f7b90f8e21f332dd9b7bf5 before this field existed. The three repair-cycle-1 regression records declare execution commit 639054125620bb4c9043c1f1f4238151a000afe5. A re-run after this commit stays PASS and includes the new HEAD in the payload, so the stdout hash differs. Inputs are unchanged. This check does not transfer the four-lane campaign.

execution_state_registration: Deferred to the post-verify state sync. This unit does not edit EXECUTION_STATE.json, MODEL_HANDOFF.json, or ITERATION_LOG.md.

head_measurement.measured_at: worktree evidence plus the three new records, equivalent to the merge because origin/main changed no evidence file since the merge-base

preventive_review.disposition: Accepted. The advisory expected this unit record after the qualifying campaign. This record is that candidate. The finding is not contested and its text is not copied.

reviewer.independence_limits: Revisore di riserva LOOP-GROK-PRIMARY (2026-11-10) e GROK-50X (2026-11-10): stesso fornitore (xAI) di un implementatore del task (Grok Build, grok-4.7), con un modello Grok di generazione diversa (cursor-grok-4.6-xhigh).

residual_risks: The classifier and the fast-path subprocess runners do not catch OSError from a missing executable. The process then exits without selecting the state-only route. The reviewed tests lock the non-zero git status path and the command-status path.
pytest_collection_modifyitems leaves an item unmarked when its source cannot be read. The marker test locks the items whose source contains the live-stack sentence.
